div.div:
· the placeholder and the settled card render the SAME bytes — only `state` differs (uploading vs done), and the 上传中 badge is absolutely positioned so it never adds a line
· the card root is borderless: with the primitive's 1px frame the root box would be 2px larger than the trigger box the settled card measures through — border-0 makes root box ≡ trigger box
· .spec-chip family classes survive as zero-rule hooks on the trigger, so spec-brief-card's a.spec-chip / img.spec-chip-img and chief-composer-tools' .spec-chip locators keep working unchanged
